name: windows-system-monitor-video
description: Dev-only: records the README video from the running console (docs/video.md). Not part of the runtime, the Docker image or CI.

scripts.video:dry: playwright test --grep @dry && node cues.mjs out/dry && node compose.mjs out/dry --cut-gaps
scripts.video:ollama: playwright test --grep @ollama && node cues.mjs out/ollama && node compose.mjs out/ollama --cut-gaps --readme
